meta.name: DAHLIA Shock Transfer: Jun Megami Reborn - The Miraculous Venus Descends
meta.description: It is truly a miracle. Jun Megami, the super-exclusive star of FALENO, has descended upon DAHLIA as it seeks to build a new era. With her overwhelming beauty, an eroticism that captivates the hearts of fans, and a passion for dramatic works, she is the absolute Venus that DAHLIA needs as it aims for the top.
